comparison.objective: Pull a nail without marking painted trim by using a scrap fulcrum; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a protective block, engage a claw, and lever under load versus unlock, rotate, relock, and dynamically test an adjuster.
comparison.success_condition: Nail raised 17 mm with no hammer-paint contact versus two repeatable non-bottoming cycles. Candidate lacks complete numeric rebound/overload/drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Both involve force control and damage avoidance, but the tested contact mechanics and objective differ.
